settings.heading: Our Story
settings.hero_tagline: Modern Emirati elegance, where the grace of Arabian heritage meets the refinement of contemporary design.
settings.lead: Every woman carries a story of strength, grace and individuality. At ZARIA, we create fashion that reflects her story, with confidence, sophistication and effortless elegance.
settings.signature: The House of ZARIA · United Arab Emirates

settings.heading: Born in the United Arab Emirates
settings.text: ZARIA embodies Modern Emirati Elegance, inspired by the UAE's balance of tradition and modernity. Our collections reinterpret modest fashion for today's woman, rooted in the grace of Arabian heritage and refined for contemporary life.

settings.heading: Made by hand, with intention
settings.text: Every ZARIA piece is thoughtfully created with premium fabrics, graceful silhouettes, refined tailoring and elegant details. For us, luxury is found in simplicity, quality and exceptional craftsmanship, in the beauty of a perfect silhouette.

settings.heading: Dressed for every occasion
settings.text: From everyday moments and business occasions to family gatherings and special celebrations, ZARIA moves effortlessly with her, celebrating modesty without ever compromising individuality.

settings.title: Premium fabrics
settings.text: Silks, cottons and chiffons, thoughtfully sourced for their beauty and quality.

settings.title: Refined details
settings.text: Graceful silhouettes and elegant finishing, made with care.

settings.title: Emirati elegance
settings.text: Modern design rooted in the grace of Arabian heritage.

settings.heading: Design your look
settings.body: Commission a piece made only for you. Share your vision, your measurements and your occasion, and our designers will bring it to life.
